software.name: imbalanced-learn
software.what: Resampling (SMOTE variants, under-sampling, combos), imbalance-aware ensembles, and metrics (geometric_mean_score, classification_report_imbalanced) compatible with scikit-learn.
software.relevance: Default tool for multi-class resampling; has no CBA.

software.name: Multi_Imbalance (MATLAB/Octave)
software.what: Multi-class resampling and ensemble methods (e.g., PIBoost, AdaBoost variants) from the Multi-Imbalance KBS paper.
software.relevance: Companion to Mosley-era multi-class work; does not reference CBA (grep of clone for Mosley, CBA, class balance accuracy: 0 hits).

software.name: multi-imbalance (Python)
software.what: Python port of multi-class imbalance methods (SOUP, MDO, global CS, SPIDER3, etc.).
software.relevance: No CBA reference (grep 0 hits). Low activity.

software.name: smote-variants
software.what: About 85 SMOTE-style oversamplers with a multi-class wrapper and model-selection framework.
software.relevance: Large catalog of oversamplers; multi-class via wrapper.

software.name: imbalanced-ensemble (imbens)
software.what: Ensemble methods (resampling and reweighting boosting/bagging) with multi-class support and visualization.
software.relevance: Practical multi-class ensembles; paper IMBENS arXiv 2111.12776.

software.name: scikit-learn: balanced_accuracy_score and class_weight
software.what: balanced_accuracy_score (macro recall, optional chance adjustment); class_weight='balanced' on many estimators; also f1/recall with average='macro'.
software.relevance: Closest built-in to CBA, but balanced accuracy differs from CBA (it ignores precision). User guide cites Mosley2013.

software.name: TorchMetrics
software.what: MulticlassAccuracy with average='macro' (macro recall), MulticlassRecall, MulticlassF1Score, confusion matrix, MCC.
software.relevance: GPU-friendly per-class metrics; macro recall equals balanced accuracy; no CBA found.

software.name: PyCM
software.what: Multiclass confusion matrix library with 100+ class and overall statistics.
software.relevance: Only mainstream package found with a CBA overall statistic (cm.CBA).

software.name: themis
software.what: recipes steps for up/down-sampling and SMOTE-family methods.
software.relevance: R resampling inside tidymodels.

software.name: yardstick
software.what: Tidy metrics including bal_accuracy, f_meas, mcc, kap with macro/micro averaging for multi-class.
software.relevance: bal_accuracy is macro recall, not CBA.

software.name: UBL
software.what: Utility-based learning resampling for classification and regression.
software.relevance: Relevant to relevance-based evaluation; currently not installable from CRAN.

software.name: ROSE
software.what: Random over-sampling examples; binary focus.
software.relevance: Binary only; stale.

software.name: imbalance (R)
software.what: Preprocessing algorithms (oversampling, filtering) for imbalanced datasets.
software.relevance: Removed from CRAN; GitHub mirror cran/imbalance exists.

software.name: mlr3 / mlr3measures
software.what: mlr3 framework and measures (bacc, mcc, ce, multiclass auc) plus pipeline-based class balancing in mlr3pipelines.
software.relevance: bacc is multi-class macro recall; no CBA found.

software.name: Imbalance.jl
software.what: Resampling toolbox (SMOTE variants, random methods) with MLJ integration.
software.relevance: Julia option; multi-class handled by ratios dictionary.

software.name: LibAUC
software.what: Losses and optimizers for AUROC, AUPRC, and related imbalance-robust objectives.
software.relevance: Metric-optimizing training for imbalanced data, mostly binary/multi-label.

software.name: Long-Tailed-Recognition.pytorch
software.what: Benchmark code for long-tailed classification methods (decoupling, causal norm, re-weighting).
software.relevance: Reference implementations for loss/classifier rebalancing.

software.name: Awesome-LongTailed-Learning
software.what: Curated list of long-tailed learning papers and code; companion to the TPAMI survey.
software.relevance: Reading-list companion.

software.name: imbalanced-dataset-sampler
software.what: Drop-in PyTorch sampler that rebalances class frequency in DataLoaders.
software.relevance: Simple practical baseline.

software.name: Reference code: LDAM-DRW, class-balanced-loss, RIDE, SADE, BalPoE
software.what: Authors' repos: kaidic/LDAM-DRW, richardaecn/class-balanced-loss, frank-xwang/RIDE-LongTailRecognition, YifanZhang07/SADE-AgnosticLT, emasa/BalPoE-CalibratedLT.
software.relevance: Reference implementations for papers in the reading list; research code, not maintained as libraries.

cba_implementations.name: PyCM
cba_implementations.notes: A confusion-matrix library with more than 100 statistics. CBA is available as ConfusionMatrix.CBA and has been in the library since version 1.4. The documentation cites the dissertation.

cba_implementations.name: pxtextmining
cba_implementations.notes: A patient-feedback text classification project. Release 0.3.0 has a class_balance_accuracy_score function that cites the dissertation by page. Later releases dropped it.

cba_implementations.name: pxtextmineR
cba_implementations.notes: An R wrapper around the pxtextmining function. It calls the Python code through reticulate, so it is not a separate implementation.

cba_implementations.name: scikit-learn user guide
cba_implementations.notes: Describes class balanced accuracy and cites the dissertation, but ships no function for it. balanced_accuracy_score computes macro recall.
